_about: Words for the Typing Trainer (/typing/). 'warmup' maps each session TITLE (exactly as in sessions.json) to 8-12 key words that pupils type in the 10-minute warm-up. 'bank' is the practice text. The build puts all of this inside typing/typing.js, so it also works in the Offline Club Kit.
